title: Junior Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist - Berkshire - Hybrid (3-4 Days) - Up to £50,000

We're working with a company who have introduced a brand-new Data Scientist position to support their Head of Analytics in delivering data for successful business solutions.

You'll build machine learning, forecasting and identity resolution solutions on Snowflake and Azure DevOps, with models powering web apps, mobile apps and Power BI.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Proficient experience using AI/ML in Snowflake.
  • Hands-on experience building, testing and training ML models, including classification, forecasting and inference.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau or other visualisation tools.
  • Knowledge of Medallion Architectures.
  • Exposure to Machine Learning algorithms and predictive modelling.

Why Apply?

  • Opportunity to shape a new role.
  • Working with a modern data and AI stack.
  • Grow alongside an organisation - huge opportunity for progression in data science.
  • Hybrid working structure.

This role is great if you're still grounding yourself in the data and AI space, especially if you're looking to gain some strong knowledge on the impact of AI on a business.

Interested? Get in touch with Joshua at for more info.

All applicants MUST be UK-based with full right to work in the UK and be eligible for SC Clearance.
